steps.note: Open the single-stage creation screen without entering a title.

Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and set Quantity Requested to 10 without setting the title.
Confirm the requested product was selected.
Confirm the product automatically filled the expected variant.
Select the mapped delivery location that should appear in the generated title.
Confirm the delivery location was applied.
